title: Klaviyo deepens Dublin investment with new EMEA headquarters at One Le Pole Square
body_markdown:
# Klaviyo deepens Dublin investment with new EMEA headquarters at One Le Pole Square


*New EMEA headquarters reflects Klaviyo's continued international momentum and Dublin's growing role in the company's expansion across the region*


Klaviyo (NYSE: KVYO), the autonomous B2C CRM, today announced it has signed a 10-year lease for a new, larger home for its EMEA headquarters at One Le Pole Square in Dublin, deepening its long-term investment in Ireland as the company’s business across the region continues to grow. Klaviyo expects its Dublin team to grow to more than 250 people.


Klaviyo will move from its current office on Dame Street to a new 57,264 square-foot space at One Le Pole Square, a short distance away. Expected to open in 2027, the new EMEA headquarters will give Klaviyo's growing Dublin team a permanent home built to bring people together as Klaviyo continues to grow and support more customers across the region.


Dublin anchors Klaviyo’s broader EMEA footprint, which also includes teams in London, Paris and Munich.


The investment comes as Klaviyo continues to experience strong international growth. In Q2 2026, its revenue outside the Americas grew 35% year-over-year, with EMEA revenue outside the UK growing more than 41% year-over-year. International markets now make up 37% of Klaviyo's total revenue, up from 35% a year earlier.


“The team we’ve built in Dublin already plays an important role in how Klaviyo serves our customers across EMEA. This isn’t a satellite office. We’re building a team here that has real ownership and is making important decisions about how we grow and operate across the region,” said Carmel Galvin, Chief People Officer at Klaviyo. “This investment gives that team a permanent home built for the work ahead. For builders who want real ownership, meaningful problems to solve, and the chance to help shape Klaviyo’s growth in EMEA, Dublin is going to be an exciting place to build a career.”


“We’re delighted to welcome Klaviyo to One Le Pole Square. From the outset, the ambition has been to create an environment that can support how leading international businesses want to operate today - bringing teams together in a high quality, well connected environment,’ said Padraic Rhatigan, Chairman, Rhatigan Group. “We look forward to working closely with Klaviyo as we collaborate on creating its new EMEA headquarters in the heart of Dublin.”


**About Klaviyo**


Klaviyo (CLAY-vee-oh) is an autonomous B2C CRM that powers more valuable customer experiences. We unify a flexible, scalable data platform, intelligence that gets smarter with every interaction, and action across Marketing and Service to help businesses turn real-time customer data into personalization at scale. High-growth enterprises like Mattel, TaylorMade, Glossier, Liquid Death, Daily Harvest and more than 205,000 other paying customers leverage Klaviyo's actionable infrastructure and our more than 350 integrations to deliver measurable outcomes through faster, higher-quality experiences.
